CA DEBABRATA MOHANTY
Chartered Accountant | Financial Planning & Analysis
+91-7377439405   |   happy.debabrata@gmail.com   |   linkedin.com/in/ca-debabrata-mohanty   |   Bengaluru, India
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Chartered Accountant with 4 years of progressive FP&A and financial controllership experience across a Big 4-caliber MNC 
(Accenture) and a large industrial conglomerate (JSW Group). Skilled in financial statement preparation under IND AS and U.S. GAAP, 
fixed asset capitalization exceeding ₹22,000 crore, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis. Proven track record of partnering 
with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to drive reporting accuracy, cost efficiency, and data-backed strategic decisions 
using SAP S/4 HANA.
CORE COMPETENCIES
Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)  •  Record to Report (RTR)  •  Financial Controllership  •  Budgeting & Forecasting  •  Variance Analysis  
•  Financial Reporting (IND AS / US GAAP)  •  General Ledger & Month-End Close  •  Fixed Asset Capitalization  •  CWIP Reconciliation  •  
Board & MIS Reporting  •  SAP S/4 HANA & FICO  •  Internal Controls & Audit Support  •  Stakeholder Management  •  Cost Optimization  •  
KPI Tracking
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Deputy Manager – Finance Planning & Analysis / Financial Controller  |  JSW GBS LimitedAug 2024 – Present
	• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in compliance with IND AS, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and 
alignment with regulatory requirements.

	• Perform monthly General Ledger (GL) scrutiny, identifying discrepancies and passing re-grouping and adjustment entries to 
strengthen financial reporting integrity.

	• Manage capitalization of fixed assets exceeding ₹22,000 crore, including allocation of pre-operative expenses, in compliance 
with IND AS 16.

	• Conduct periodic reconciliation and ageing analysis of Capital Work in Progress (CWIP) and project inventory to ensure timely 
capitalization and inventory utilization.

	• Prepare and support internal and external audit requirements relating to fixed assets.

	• Prepare quarterly Board Presentation decks by consolidating data from financial statements, SAP reports, and MIS dashboards 
for senior stakeholders.

	• Ensure alignment between MIS reports and GL balances, coordinating with cross-functional teams to maintain data integrity and 
reporting accuracy.


Client Financial Management Analyst (FP&A)  |  Accenture Solutions Pvt. Ltd. Aug 2022 – Aug 2024
	• Led planning and budgeting activities for the financial year, including monthly, quarterly, and annual variance analysis of actuals 
versus plan.

	• Prepared capitalization and amortization schedules in accordance with Accenture's internal policies and accounting standards.

	• Partnered with senior leadership to review and finalize monthly forecasts, ensuring alignment with business objectives and 
financial targets.

	• Executed internal controls to ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, Accenture finance policies, and local statutory requirements.

	• Prepared monthly flash reports and variance analyses for leadership review, ensuring accuracy of financial forecasts.

	• Posted monthly journal entries and managed FICO-related activities in SAP to ensure accurate financial reporting.

	• Analyzed financial performance monthly, quarterly, and annually, comparing actual results against projections and plans.

	• Led monthly project financial health reviews, escalating identified and anticipated risks to onshore delivery leads with 
recommended mitigation strategies.

	• Reviewed key operational metrics daily to identify unusual trends and flag issues for further investigation.

	• Compiled and maintained the company's business plan as a key tool for forecasting and strategic planning.


Article Assistant  |  AASA & Associates and P.K. Dhal & Co. Jan 2018 – Jan 2021
	• Performed statutory audit of Punjab National Bank (PNB), including preparation of Long Form Audit Reports and identification 
and reporting of Non-Performing Assets (NPAs).

	• Handled GST return filings (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B) and annual return filings for client engagements.


https://www.linkedin.com/in/ca-debabrata-mohanty-509249189

	• Conducted concurrent audit of Corporation Bank, including in-depth review and reporting of irregularities, statutory compliance, 
and daily cash limit checks.


EDUCATION
Chartered Accountancy (CA Final)  –  Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) May 2022
CA Intermediate  –  Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) Nov 2017
CA Common Proficiency Test (CPT)  –  Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) Dec 2015
Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.)  –  Utkal University 2017
TECHNICAL SKILLS
SAP S/4 HANA & SAP FICO  •  Tally  •  Advanced MS Excel  •  MS PowerPoint  •  MS Word  •  SAP Analytics
ACHIEVEMENTS & RECOGNITION
	• JSW 2026 – Talent Spotlight Award

	• JSW 2026 – The Super Squad Award, Annual Award Ceremony (JASHN)

	• JSW 2025 – Best Employee of the Quarter (Q1)

	• Accenture Encore Awards 2024 – Core Value Champion Award

	• Accenture Encore Awards 2023 – Great Start New Joiner Award


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
	• Attended Global Holistic Leadership Program – Spiritual & Yoga Session

	• Regular participant in ICAI seminars and professional development sessions

	• Active participant in sports and team activities
